name: Uptime Kuma
description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with status pages and notifications.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    container_name: panelpro-uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{ http_port }}:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
volumes:
  uptime_kuma_data:
install_script:
set -e
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose up -d
echo "Uptime Kuma: http://<server>:{{ http_port }}"
uninstall_script:
cd {{ app_home }} && docker compose down -v || true
echo "Uptime Kuma stack removed"
